_comment: operationId -> generated method name, grouped by the SDK module/attribute it belongs to (docs/sdk-plan.md section 4). Method names not overridden here fall back to generate.py's default naming rule (section 8): GET no id -> list, GET with trailing {id} -> retrieve, POST no extra segment -> create, PUT/PATCH with trailing {id} -> update, DELETE with trailing {id} -> delete, anything else -> snake_case of the trailing path segment(s). generate.py fails if an operationId in the spec under one of `services` below is missing from its module's `ops`, and fails if `ops` names an operationId the spec doesn't have.
_pilot_scope_note: F3 pilot (2026-09-19): only `system` and `credentials` are populated — both are pure JSON (no multipart), which keeps the pilot's risk down per docs/sdk-plan.md phase F3. `hosts` and the rest of the 491 operations are F4 work.
